propositions: The existing checker (R1/R2) enforces no-raw-subprocess-git but misses hand-rolled non-atomic git-adapter primitive sequences composed outside the transaction seam because it sanctions at module granularity rather than composition.

R3 must fire on calls to git-adapter mutation primitives (add, commit, commit_tree, read_tree, rm_cached, update_ref, write_tree) made from outside the sanctioned seam files, detected via resolved import/dynamic-loader bindings of the git_adapter module reference.
The sanctioned entry set (where R3 never fires) is exactly git_adapter.py, _ref_lock.py, and _ref_lock_push.py; exceptions elsewhere are marked inline with # raw-git-ok: <reason>.

Two confirmed out-of-transaction composition sites (_commit_binding_store_snapshot and _purge_committed_reconciler_locks) require durable reasoned markers, not debt-baseline placeholders, as disposition.
R3's receiver binding must be keyed on exact repo-relative path, not filename alone, to prevent opt-out-by-lookalike and enforce that sanction is earned by residency not claimed by name.
Reusing the existing # raw-git-ok: marker vocabulary (not minting a second marker) keeps one sanction vocabulary and makes marker-without-reason violations cover R3 for free.
